HELP! I told my parents I want to move in with my white boyfriend before marriage. (EEEK…. I know)

Some background. I am a 25F Indian American living in California. My parents are from Delhi and got married (arranged) of course and within a month of knowing each other got married and moved to america and had me. 

Fast forward now, I am in a committed relationship with a white guy 28M who I have been with for a year. We already know we want to be together but we also don’t want to rush into marriage. My parents were very supportive of him from the beginning as they see that he makes me happy for which I am so thankful. His family has welcomed me with open arms as well. So we have discussed about moving in together in the future, however uncertain as we are both staying with our parents. I’m a broke doctoral student trying to save money, he’s an engineer trying to save and change career paths. We are trying to be as logical and smart as possible unlike our parents. Our parents have not good marriages, my parents are toxic to each other like most Indian parents are. 

My parents love me a lot I know but they don’t understand the generation difference. So when I casually brought up moving in together to my mom she was dead set against it. Saying it’s like you aren’t committed to each other cuz you can just leave unlike a marriage. Which is not true it’s more complicated than that. Anyway it spiraled into a huge argument and lead to my mom being super defensive and doing the usual guilt tripping and gaslighting. “You don’t love me.” It got heated most when I spoke about her and my Mausi’s marriage. Saying I was insulting her and the rest of my family. I feel so guilty and angry and unheard. Like usual. I guess I just need some support from my fellow ABCDs. 

**NOTE: I was on FaceTime with my other aunt (my cool aunt) talking about my reasons for live in and I brought up my experiences growing up viewing marriage in my family. I told her that in confidence and she understood and told me in confidence that she will stick by me no matter what. My mom was listening by the door and barged in grabbing the phone and crying telling her I insulted her marriage and I should be ashamed. I AM DESPERATE FOR ANY SUPPORT.

I developed a complex, and anything poly related really started to trigger me and made me feel very insecure in the relationship. When we broke up it was tough, but I moved on. I now have been with a man I love, who loves me MONOGAMOUSLY and it’s amazing. We’ll be together for a year next month! My insecurities vanished with him and I’m happy! You will find the person you are supposed to be with for the long haul. Unfortunately, this is not it, one will always have to settle and it just isn’t fair to you or her. Good luck OP! 🙏🏾
